notes: Mangara, the Diplomat, printed: 'Whenever an opponent attacks with creatures, if two or more of those creatures are attacking you and/or planeswalkers you control, draw a card.' The intervening 'if' is read again as the ability resolves (CR 603.4). Seat 1's two creatures attack: one attacks seat 0, one attacks seat 0's planeswalker, so the trigger goes on the stack. In response seat 1 gains control of that planeswalker (an effect, the gain_control op): it is no longer a planeswalker seat 0 controls, so only ONE attacking creature is attacking 'you and/or planeswalkers you control' as the ability resolves, and seat 0 draws nothing (hand 0). Seat 1 keeps the walker (5 loyalty) and drew for its turn; the unblocked creature takes seat 0 to 18.
